The image presents two line plots, each with a distinct set of data and axes. Both plots share the same x-axis, which represents years from 1995 to 2020 with a linear scale and tick labels at 5-year intervals.

The left plot illustrates the relationship between the IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat over time. The x-axis, as mentioned, spans from 1995 to 2020. The left y-axis, labeled "IWF Fiskalindex," has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2.5 with a tick label interval of 0.5. The right y-axis, labeled "Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat," has a linear scale from 60 to 120 with a tick label interval of 20. The plot features two lines: a blue line with triangle markers representing the IWF Fiskalindex, and a purple line representing Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat. The blue line starts at approximately 0 in 1995, peaks at around 1 in 2009, and then declines to nearly 0 in 2020. The purple line begins at around 60 in 1995, increases to approximately 85 in 2010, and then rises sharply to around 115 in 2020.

The right plot displays the relationship between the IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote Zentralstaat over time, sharing the same x-axis as the left plot. The left y-axis is again labeled "IWF Fiskalindex" with the same scale as the left plot. The right y-axis, labeled "Schuldenquote Zentralstaat," has a linear scale from 30 to 70 with a tick label interval of 10. This plot also features two lines: a blue line with triangle markers for the IWF Fiskalindex, and a purple line for Schuldenquote Zentralstaat. The blue line starts at around -2 in 1995, peaks at approximately 1 in 2009, and then declines to around -1 in 2020. The purple line begins at around 35 in 1995, increases to approximately 45 in 2010, and then rises sharply to around 65 in 2020.

Both plots show the IWF Fiskalindex and respective debt quotes over time, with the IWF Fiskalindex peaking around 2009 and declining thereafter, while the debt quotes continue to rise, especially after 2010.
